title: Abnormal cases in the UE, SMS services not accepted

entities.name: ATTACH ACCEPT
entities.description: Message received during attach procedure that may contain SMS services status IE.

entities.name: SMS services status IE
entities.description: Information element in ATTACH ACCEPT message indicating SMS service status.

entities.name: Timer T3410
entities.description: Timer that is stopped when abnormal SMS services case occurs.

entities.name: Timer T3411
entities.description: Timer started when tracking area updating attempt counter is less than 5, triggers tracking area updating procedure upon expiry.

entities.name: Timer T3402
entities.description: Timer started when tracking area updating attempt counter equals 5, triggers tracking area updating procedure upon expiry.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: EMM state entered when UE sets EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED during abnormal SMS services case.

entities.name: EPS update status EU1 UPDATED
entities.description: EPS update status set to EU1 UPDATED when UE enters EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.

entities.name: Tracking area updating attempt counter
entities.description: Counter that is incremented during abnormal SMS services case, unless already set to 5.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure triggered when timer T3411 or T3402 expires, can be normal or combined tracking area updating for EPS services and SMS only.

relations.description: ATTACH ACCEPT message contains SMS services status IE.
When ATTACH ACCEPT contains specific SMS services status IE value, UE stops timer T3410.
UE starts timer T3411 when tracking area updating attempt counter is less than 5.
UE starts timer T3402 when tracking area updating attempt counter equals 5.
When timer T3411 expires, UE triggers tracking area updating procedure.
When timer T3402 expires, UE triggers tracking area updating procedure.
Setting EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED establishes EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.
